title: 拉爾達隧道~Laerdal Tunnel
focus: 長公路的人因、通風與更新介面~Human factors, ventilation and renewal in a long road tunnel
summary: 拉爾達隧道官方列長24.5公里，於2000年11月開通；同一官方頁也說明後續更新工程。本課將原始營運與更新情境分開，從長距離行車視覺、岩體應力、通風及水量出發，追蹤夜間工程窗口和恢復營運的證據需求，避免以景觀照明取代完整系統評估。~The road authority reports Laerdal as 24.5 km long and opened in November 2000, while also describing later upgrades. This course separates original service from renewal scenarios, following driver vision, rock stress, ventilation and water into night-work windows and evidence for restoring service. Decorative lighting is not treated as a substitute for system assessment.

units.anchor: 路線里程與端點~Alignment chainage and endpoints
units.title: 服務邊界與路線代價~Service boundaries and alignment cost
units.mechanism: 拉爾達長距離道路的需求包含冬季連通與維修繞行，不能只以自由車流穿越時間代表整體服務。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。~A long road crossing serves continuity and maintenance diversion as well as free-flow travel; journey time alone does not capture the service. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
units.model: 原創教學假設：長度=16 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=16 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為17.6 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: length=16 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=16 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 17.6 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 比較相同端點的正常、封閉及替代路線假設。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare normal, closed and diversion cases between identical endpoints. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 忽略封閉時替代路線會低估更新工程對使用者的影響。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。~Omitting the diversion understates the user impact of renewal closures. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.
units.misconception: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。~The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
units.practice: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：比較相同端點的正常、封閉及替代路線假設。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。~For Laerdal Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Compare normal, closed and diversion cases between identical endpoints. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

units.anchor: 洞壁切向應力~Tangential wall stress
units.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配~Cover stress and wall redistribution
units.mechanism: 官方更新頁指出岩體高應力使施工具挑戰，本課研究既有洞壁再擾動與新開挖的應力差異。開挖使岩體洞壁失去徑向拘束，遠場荷載轉移到周圍岩體，局部切向應力可能升高。圓孔彈性解可辨識量級，但節理、非圓斷面、塑性區與原位應力比會改變峰值位置，不能只用覆土重量推定全部三維應力。~The authority identifies high rock stress as a renewal challenge; examine differences between disturbing an existing wall and making a new opening. Excavation removes radial confinement at the wall and transfers load through the surrounding rock, potentially raising local tangential stress. An elastic circular-hole solution identifies scale, but joints, noncircular geometry, yielding and the in-situ stress ratio alter the peak location. Cover weight alone cannot establish the complete three-dimensional stress state or support demand.
units.model: 原創教學假設：覆土深度=800 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=62.4 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為68.64 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: cover=800 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=62.4 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 68.64 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將舊剝落圖與新施工位移對齊，辨識局部擾動範圍。將原位應力量測、岩石試驗及洞壁破壞方位相互比較，再用多點伸長計檢查變形是否與所假設應力方向一致。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Align old spalling maps and new movement to identify local disturbance. Compare in-situ stress measurements, rock tests and wall-damage orientation, then use multipoint extensometers to test consistency with the assumed stress directions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 舊洞已存在多年不代表局部再開挖不會重分配應力。把彈性峰值直接當岩體強度可能誤判支護需求；相反地忽略剝落或擠壓也會讓局部破壞逐步侵入淨空。~Long-standing excavation does not prevent stress redistribution from local new work. Equating an elastic peak with rock-mass strength misjudges support demand; overlooking spalling or squeezing lets damage progressively consume clearance.
units.misconception: 知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。~Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
units.practice: 本案「洞壁切向應力」的交付需回答：將舊剝落圖與新施工位移對齊，辨識局部擾動範圍。保留應力模型的座標、邊界和材料假設，量測與預測不符時先核對代表性，再由岩力設計者選擇非線性或節理模型。~For Laerdal Tunnel, the tangential wall stress handover must address the following evidence: Align old spalling maps and new movement to identify local disturbance. Record stress-model coordinates, boundaries and material assumptions; when observations disagree, check representativeness before the rock designer selects nonlinear or jointed models.

units.anchor: 支護安裝時點~Support activation time
units.title: 支護啟動與變形容量~Support activation and deformation capacity
units.mechanism: 在營運多年後更新支護的教學情境中，分開原支護劣化、新錨固啟動和施工卸載。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。~Separate deterioration of old support, activation of new anchors and construction unloading during hypothetical renewal. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
units.model: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=40 kN/mm；位移=7 mm。F=ku=280 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為308 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=40 kN/mm; movement=7 mm. F=ku=280 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 308 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 量測基線先於拆換建立，並記錄每一支護改動。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Establish the baseline before replacement and record every support change. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 拆換造成的位移若誤歸自然岩體變形會影響後續選型。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。~Misattributing replacement movement to natural ground response misdirects later support selection. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses.
units.misconception: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。~Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
units.practice: 本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：量測基線先於拆換建立，並記錄每一支護改動。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。~For Laerdal Tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Establish the baseline before replacement and record every support change. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.

units.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度~Visual adaptation and pavement luminance
units.mechanism: 長隧道的視覺節奏與障礙辨識是不同任務，拉爾達教材檢查照明變化是否改變路面對比。駕駛從洞外進入洞內時視覺適應需要時間，照度並不等同從駕駛視角看到的亮度。路面反射、濕度、燈具配光及背景對比共同影響辨識；朗伯模型只示範理想漫反射，不能直接制定入口段燈具間距或真實道路安全值。~Visual rhythm and obstacle detection are distinct tasks; examine how lighting transitions affect pavement contrast over a long drive. Driver adaptation takes time when entering a tunnel, and illuminance is not the luminance seen from the driving position. Pavement reflection, wetness, luminaire distribution and background contrast affect detection. A Lambertian model illustrates ideal diffuse reflection only; it cannot establish entrance-zone spacing or actual road-safety limits without photometric and operational assessment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：照度=100 lx；反射率=0.23 無因次。L=ρE/π=7.32113 cd/m²。僅把照度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為8.05324 cd/m²。邊界：理想朗伯漫反射，不是真實濕路面亮度；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=100 lx; reflectance=0.23 dimensionless. L=ρE/π=7.32113 cd/m². Increasing only illuminance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 8.05324 cd/m². Boundary: Ideal Lambertian reflection, not actual wet-road luminance. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 從駕駛視角比較過渡區、一般區與濕路面。以駕駛視角的亮度量測配合照度網格，分別檢查乾濕路面與燈具衰減，保留外部天空條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare transition zones, ordinary reaches and wet surfaces from the driver viewpoint. Combine driver-view luminance with illuminance grids, checking dry and wet pavement and lamp depreciation while preserving exterior sky conditions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 覺得明亮舒適不能證明所有障礙在不利背景可辨識。照度平均值合格仍可能存在低亮度障礙區或眩光，感測器沾污也會使調光系統低估外界亮度。~Perceived brightness and comfort do not prove detection against adverse backgrounds. Acceptable average illuminance can coexist with dark obstacles or glare, while sensor contamination may bias adaptive lighting controls.
units.misconception: 照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。~Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
units.practice: 本案「漫反射亮度」的交付需回答：從駕駛視角比較過渡區、一般區與濕路面。將視角、路面狀態和光度校正連同量測交付，照明調整需按核准場景測試，不把理想反射公式當驗收標準。~For Laerdal Tunnel, the diffuse luminance handover must address the following evidence: Compare transition zones, ordinary reaches and wet surfaces from the driver viewpoint. Hand over viewing geometry, pavement state and photometric calibration; test changes against approved scenarios rather than treating ideal reflection as an acceptance criterion.

units.anchor: 風道摩擦壓損~Duct friction loss
units.title: 通風網路與壓力損失~Ventilation network and pressure loss
units.mechanism: 長道路通風需保留車流活塞效應與外風，研究夜間低車流時原有風量假設是否仍適用。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。~Retain traffic piston effects and external wind, testing whether assumptions remain valid during low-traffic night work. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
units.model: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=900 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.4 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=39.015 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為47.2082 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=900 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.4 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=39.015 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 47.2082 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 比較車流高低時段同風機設定下的風速與壓差。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare flow and pressure at the same fan setting under high and low traffic. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 將白天交通助流套到夜間會高估施工區換氣。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。~Transferring daytime traffic-assisted flow to night work overstates ventilation. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air.
units.misconception: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。~Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
units.practice: 本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：比較車流高低時段同風機設定下的風速與壓差。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。~For Laerdal Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Compare flow and pressure at the same fan setting under high and low traffic. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.

units.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓~Piezometric head and lining pressure
units.mechanism: 拉爾達山區裂隙補注與道路排水在教學模型中分開，研究季節水量變化對設備更新安排的影響。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。~Separate fracture recharge from road drainage and examine seasonal water effects on renewal planning. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=75 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=735.75 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為809.325 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=75 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=735.75 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 809.325 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 按降雨與季節對照排水、水頭及堵塞紀錄。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare drainage, head and blockage records against rainfall and season. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 融雪期增流若當設備故障，可能無效更換正常泵組。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。~Treating snowmelt inflow as equipment failure can prompt needless pump replacement. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.
units.misconception: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。~No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
units.practice: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：按降雨與季節對照排水、水頭及堵塞紀錄。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。~For Laerdal Tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare drainage, head and blockage records against rainfall and season. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

units.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸~Shared access and transport bottlenecks
units.mechanism: 官方描述夜間更新與通行安排，本課將施工準備、出渣及恢復檢查從可用窗口逐項扣除。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。~For night renewal, deduct preparation, spoil handling and restoration checks from the available access window. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check.
units.model: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=30 t；往返週期=36 min。C=N payload 60/T=200 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為181.818 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=30 t; cycle=36 min. C=N payload 60/T=200 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 181.818 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 記錄首個工作面開始與最後恢復確認的時間戳。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Record first productive work and final restoration sign-off timestamps. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 以封閉總時長當有效施工時間會持續低估工期。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。~Treating full closure duration as productive time repeatedly understates programme length. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space.
units.misconception: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。~Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
units.practice: 本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：記錄首個工作面開始與最後恢復確認的時間戳。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。~For Laerdal Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Record first productive work and final restoration sign-off timestamps. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.

units.anchor: 所需疏散時間~Required evacuation time
units.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性~Evacuation time and zone availability
units.mechanism: 長距離公路事故需要辨認行車者反應延遲與路線可用性，更新區域還會改變原有標示。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。~Incident travel includes user response delay and route availability, while renewal zones can alter familiar signs. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
units.model: 原創教學假設：前置時間=100 s；行走距離=340 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=525 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為567.5 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=100 s; travel distance=340 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=525 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 567.5 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 沿現行施工階段路徑走查，分列辨識和移動時間。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Walk the current stage route and separate recognition from movement time. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只使用完工後地圖可能把人引入尚未恢復的區段。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。~A final-layout map can direct users into an unrestored section. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.
units.misconception: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。~Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
units.practice: 本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：沿現行施工階段路徑走查，分列辨識和移動時間。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。~For Laerdal Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Walk the current stage route and separate recognition from movement time. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.

units.title: 設備備援與共同失效~Equipment redundancy and common failure
units.mechanism: 更新期間臨時電源與永久控制可能共用上游供電，研究切換成功與真正冗餘的差別。兩套設備只有在故障近似獨立且切換可靠時，並聯才顯著降低不可用率。共用配電、控制軟體、冷卻或受淹位置會把獨立假設破壞；維修停用也改變當下配置，因此可靠度模型必須明列共有資源和設備狀態，不能只數備用台數。~Temporary power and permanent controls may share an upstream source; distinguish successful transfer from genuine redundancy. Parallel equipment sharply reduces unavailability only when failures are approximately independent and transfer works. Shared power, software, cooling or flood exposure breaks that assumption. Planned maintenance also changes the available configuration, so reliability models must identify shared resources and states rather than count spare units or multiply unsupported independent probabilities.
units.model: 原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.02 無因次。Uparallel=U²=0.0004 probability。僅把單機不可用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.000484 probability。邊界：完全獨立並聯與完美切換，不含共同失效；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.02 dimensionless. Uparallel=U²=0.0004 probability. Increasing only single-unit unavailability by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.000484 probability. Boundary: Independent parallel units with perfect transfer, excluding common failures. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 追查每條電源到上游共同點並核對失電測試。由設備清單畫出故障樹，將電源、控制及實體位置追到共同節點，並用事件及維修紀錄檢查獨立假設。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Trace feeds to shared upstream points and check outage tests. Build a fault tree from the asset list, trace power, control and location to shared nodes, and test independence against incident and maintenance records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 兩條電纜共用同一配電盤不能假設失效獨立。重複安裝卻共用單一供電可能在一次故障中全部停機，帳面可靠度很高但實際不可用時間沒有降低。~Two cables on one board do not justify independent-failure assumptions. Duplicated equipment on one supply can fail together in a single event, leaving actual downtime unchanged despite optimistic calculated reliability.
units.misconception: 設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。~Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
units.practice: 本案「系統不可用率」的交付需回答：追查每條電源到上游共同點並核對失電測試。維修計畫附當日可用配置與剩餘備援，任何共同資源更動同步更新故障樹，切換試驗由設備及營運團隊共同見證。~For Laerdal Tunnel, the system unavailability handover must address the following evidence: Trace feeds to shared upstream points and check outage tests. Attach the actual configuration and remaining redundancy to maintenance plans, update fault trees after shared-resource changes, and witness transfer tests jointly.

units.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接~Asset identity and traceable handover
units.mechanism: 拉爾達更新資料需保留舊新設備並存期間的狀態，避免竣工資料提前覆蓋仍在服務的舊系統。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。~Maintain coexistence states during renewal so new as-built records do not overwrite still-operating legacy systems prematurely. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
units.model: 原創教學假設：設備總數=110 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.4545 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為84 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: asset count=110 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.4545 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 84 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 抽查切換日期前後的設備狀態與控制位址。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check asset state and control address before and after transfer dates. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 提前標記已更新會讓維修人員找不到實際在線設備。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。~Premature completion status leaves maintainers unable to identify the online asset. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.
units.misconception: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。~Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
units.practice: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查切換日期前後的設備狀態與控制位址。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。~For Laerdal Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Check asset state and control address before and after transfer dates. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

example: 原創綜合審查：先計算「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」，再獨立計算「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」。原創教學假設：覆土深度=800 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=62.4 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為68.64 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=75 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=735.75 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為809.325 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。~Original integrated review: first calculate cover stress and wall redistribution, then independently calculate piezometric head and lining pressure. Original teaching assumptions: cover=800 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=62.4 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 68.64 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=75 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=735.75 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 809.325 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
history: 2000 年公開記錄：拉爾達公路隧道於11月正式開通營運。拉爾達隧道官方列長24.5公里，於2000年11月開通；同一官方頁也說明後續更新工程。本課將原始營運與更新情境分開，從長距離行車視覺、岩體應力、通風及水量出發，追蹤夜間工程窗口和恢復營運的證據需求，避免以景觀照明取代完整系統評估。本課把「長公路的人因、通風與更新介面」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。~Public record for 2000: Laerdal road tunnel formally opens to traffic in November. The road authority reports Laerdal as 24.5 km long and opened in November 2000, while also describing later upgrades. This course separates original service from renewal scenarios, following driver vision, rock stress, ventilation and water into night-work windows and evidence for restoring service. Decorative lighting is not treated as a substitute for system assessment. The course treats human factors, ventilation and renewal in a long road tunnel as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 24.5 km，保留所列來源的計量邊界。~The public scale is about 24.5 km; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
2000 年事件：拉爾達公路隧道於11月正式開通營運。~2000 event: Laerdal road tunnel formally opens to traffic in November.
教學「路線里程與端點」：長度=16 km，其餘輸入依單元，結果=16 min；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching alignment chainage and endpoints: length=16 km, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 16 min; not measured or accepted project data.
教學「洞壁切向應力」：覆土深度=800 m，其餘輸入依單元，結果=62.4 MPa；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching tangential wall stress: cover=800 m, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 62.4 MPa; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「風道摩擦壓損」：達西因子=0.025 無因次，其餘輸入依單元，結果=39.015 Pa；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching duct friction loss: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 39.015 Pa; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「測壓水頭」：水密度=1000 kg/m³，其餘輸入依單元，結果=735.75 kPa；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching piezometric head: water density=1000 kg/m³, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 735.75 kPa; not measured or accepted project data.
